newsitem.title: UK: Scottish & Newcastle seen up after results.
newsitem.headline: Scottish & Newcastle seen up after results.

text.p: Shares in British brewer Scottish and Newcastle Plc were expected to open higher on Monday after half-year profits came in at the top of expectations and the interim dividend beat analysts best forecasts.
Half-year pre-tax profits rose to 195.1 million stg from 158.2 million a year earlier. Analysts had been expecting profits of between 178-196 million stg.
The interim dividend was raised to 7.21 pence per share from 6.55 pence previously, beating most analysts forecasts of a 7.0 pence payout.
The shares closed at 639p on Friday.
In pre-market trade the shares were up 5-1/2p at 644-1/2p.
